item.title: Group report totals by account and currency
item.brief: Implement the reports side of the shared currency CSV contract. Read CSV with or without currency column; missing column means USD. Validate currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed code reports to stderr and exits 2. Sum by account and currency, emit account,currency,total_cents and sort rows by account then currency. Update README, keep existing tests passing and add/update focused tests. Run python3 -m unittest. Commit changes locally. Do not push or merge.

item.title: Emit and validate transaction currencies in ledger
item.brief: Implement the ledger side of the shared currency CSV contract. Parse the optional fourth TSV column as an ISO-style code exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, default missing currency to USD, emit CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency and include currency for every row. Invalid currency must report an error naming the 1-based input line on stderr and exit status 2; other input errors must continue to exit 1. Update README, keep existing tests passing and add/update focused tests for the new behavior. Run cargo test. Commit changes locally. Do not push or merge.

pr.body: `src/lib.rs` accepts an optional fourth TSV field, validates exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, and emits `date,account,amount_cents,currency`. `src/main.rs` maps only invalid currency to exit status 2; other input errors retain status 1. README and integration tests document and cover defaults, explicit values, validation, output and line/status behavior. Checks: `cargo fmt -- --check`, `cargo test` (5 integration tests), `git diff --check`, and direct CLI probes all passed. Review's initial low-severity error precedence observation was fixed in 48d982a and verified by follow-up review. No known limitations.
